summary: Bel Fuse Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 1,300,000 shares of its Class B common stock. The offering is a routine equity capital raise, not a special-situation transaction. The closing price on May 11, 2026, was $302.73 per share. The company is selling primary shares; underwriters have a 30-day over-allotment option. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or other special-situation element. This is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5), and the filing does not trigger any special-situations classification.
